newsitem.title: FRANCE: Trichet repeats strong dollar in interests of all.
newsitem.headline: Trichet repeats strong dollar in interests of all.

text.p: Bank of France governor Jean-Claude Trichet said in an interview there is a wide consensus that a strong dollar is in the interest of all.

Trichet made the comments in an interview with the entertainment weekly VSD to be published on Thursday. He has said several times in recent days that the dollar had room to appreciate against European currencies and that a strong dollar is in everyone's interest.
"There is a very wide agreement which considers that a strong dollar is in the interests of all, Europeans as well as Americans," Trichet was quoted as saying in the interview.
